items.headline: College football Bottom 10 after Week 6: Texas takes major fall
items.description: There's no mercy for Texas: One loss and the Longhorns land on our dubious list.

items.headline: Air Force does not complete a pass, beats Northern Illinois in the Huskies' first Mountain West game
items.description: — Evan Medders and Owen Allen combined for more than 200 yards rushing and four scores for Air Force, and the Falcons beat Northern Illinois 28-7 on Saturday night in the Mountain West Conference inaugural for the Huskies.

items.headline: College football Bottom 10 after Week 5: Michigan is back for more
items.description: Apparently the Wolverines were so comfortable on our dubious list last week, they decided to stick around.

items.headline: Air Force and Northern Illinois meet in MWC play
items.description: Air Force (3-1) at Northern Illinois (0-4), Oct. 10 at 7:30 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: College football Bottom 10 after Week 4: Time not on Michigan's side
items.description: After a controversial last-second win earlier in the season, the tables were turned on the Wolverines.

items.headline: Dorsey, McCrary power Georgia State over Northern Illinois 35-14
items.description: — Rodshaun Dorsey caught five passes for 114 yards and two touchdowns, Lanear McCrary Jr. rushed for 111 yards and one touchdown, and Georgia State defeated Northern Illinois 35-14 on Saturday.
